head: sok
rule: ศก is hair (1) or a count of years (2-4), and the compound's own gloss says which kind of count. A name built from a numeral is sense 3, the gloss for which is itself the rule for naming a จุลศักราช year by its last digit; a name built from a cycle animal is glossed plainly ปีX, so ศก stands for ปี and files at 4. Hair keeps the one royal verb whose other half is กันต์ 'to cut, shave'.
